events.name: Red Bull New York at Columbus Crew

headlines.description: Ronald Donkor scored in the 89th minute and Ethan Horvath made three saves to help the New York Red Bulls end a six-match winless streak with a 1-0 victory over the Columbus Crew on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Donkor goals sees Red Bulls beat Crew to end winless streak at 6

events.name: Atlanta United FC at D.C. United

headlines.description: Sean Johnson had two saves Saturday night for D.C. United in a 0-0 tie with Atlanta United.
headlines.shortLinkText: Sean Johnson has 2 saves for DC United in 0-0 tie with Atlanta

events.name: Nashville SC at Inter Miami CF

headlines.description: Lionel Messi scored his MLS-leading 19th goal of the season as Inter Miami played first-place Nashville to a 2-2 tie on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Messi scores his 19th MLS goal as Inter Miami draws 2-2 with Nashville

events.name: Toronto FC at Orlando City SC

headlines.description: Antoine Griezmann scored for the eighth time in 10 matches, and rookie Harvey Sarajian notched his first goal and assist to spark Orlando City to a 3-0 victory over Toronto FC on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Griezmann scores in 5th straight to help Orlando beat Toronto

headlines.description: André Luiz and Taylor Calheira scored first-half goals and Sporting Kansas City shocked Los Angeles FC with a 3-1 victory on Saturday night that ended a seven-match winless streak.
headlines.shortLinkText: André Luiz, Taylor Calheira help Sporting KC stun LAFC 3-1 to end long winless streak
